name: MAIO – ChatGPT SEO Tracking & AI Search Optimization for WordPress
author: HBSS Technologies

sections.description:
MAIO is an AI SEO plugin for WordPress designed to help websites optimize for ChatGPT, AI search engines, and large language models (LLMs).
As AI search replaces traditional search results, websites must optimize not only for Google, but also for AI discovery and generative search.

MAIO helps you:

• Improve ChatGPT SEO visibility
• Optimize for AI search engines
• Increase LLM discoverability
• Strengthen AI optimization signals
• Monitor AI indexing behavior

If you are looking for an AI SEO plugin for WordPress that helps optimize for ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and generative AI systems – MAIO provides structured signals and AI visibility insights.

New: MAIO for Shopify

Exciting news: MAIO is now available for Shopify stores too. If you run a Shopify store, you can bring the same AI visibility tracking and optimization to it.

Get it on the Shopify App Store: https://apps.shopify.com/maio-ai-optimization

AI SEO for WordPress

If you are searching for an AI SEO WordPress plugin, MAIO provides structured AI optimization and AI visibility tools built specifically for WordPress.
MAIO is built specifically as an AI SEO plugin for WordPress.
It helps WordPress websites optimize for ChatGPT SEO, AI search engines, and large language models (LLMs).
Unlike traditional SEO plugins that focus only on Google, MAIO focuses on AI visibility and AI-powered discovery.

ChatGPT SEO Optimization

MAIO improves ChatGPT SEO by enhancing structured AI signals, content clarity, and AI discovery optimization for WordPress websites.

ChatGPT SEO Tracking for WordPress

MAIO allows you to track your website’s visibility in ChatGPT and other AI search engines. Monitor AI crawler activity, detect AI referrals, and understand how your content appears inside AI-generated responses.

Privacy Policy

This plugin:
* Does not collect any personal data
* Does not track user behavior
* Does not share data with third parties
* Stores only the information you provide in the settings
* GDPR: no visitor profiling; data handling is limited to what you save in plugin settings and what your WordPress site already processes.

Security

  • All data is sanitized and validated
  • Follows WordPress security best practices
  • Regular security updates
  • No external API calls without user consent
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/maio-the-new-ai-geo-seo-tool directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. That’s it! MAIO works out of the box with no configuration needed
sections.faq:
What is a ChatGPT SEO tracking plugin?

A ChatGPT SEO tracking plugin helps WordPress websites monitor their visibility inside ChatGPT and AI-powered search systems. MAIO provides tracking, analytics, and optimization tools to improve AI search presence.

How does MAIO work?

MAIO optimizes your website for AI discovery by adding structured signals that help AI tools accurately understand and represent your content. The plugin automatically tracks engagement from major AI systems, including:
* OpenAI ChatGPT
* Anthropic Claude
* Perplexity AI
* Google Gemini
* Meta AI

Does MAIO help with ChatGPT SEO?

Yes. MAIO is specifically built to improve ChatGPT SEO and AI search visibility by enhancing structured AI signals on your WordPress site.
MAIO provides real-time analytics showing which AI systems are discovering your content, what pages they’re indexing, and how your brand appears in AI-generated responses.

Is MAIO available for Shopify?

Yes. MAIO is now on the Shopify App Store, so Shopify stores get the same AI visibility tracking and optimization: https://apps.shopify.com/maio-ai-optimization
